name: Thumbnail Image
author: hearth-team
description: Generate a 16:9 thumbnail (YouTube / blog hero) from a concept. Calls the configured image provider with a high-contrast bold composition preset. Pass `concept` for what the thumbnail should show; optional `headline` for big-text overlay.

family.name: AI Image Family
family.description: Headshots, inpainting, wardrobe swap, logos, social posts. Pick a provider (OpenAI / KIE / Higgsfield / Replicate / fal / Stability / Recraft / Ideogram) and your favorite task — sub-skills route through whichever provider you've configured.

settings.label: Preferred provider
settings.help: Ideogram is recommended when the thumbnail needs readable text.
